title: NefactPlugin
description: Adds powerful custom artifacts to Minecraft, including the Swap Rod, Stun Slam Mace, and Gateway, each featuring unique gameplay mechanics.
body:
# NefactPlugin
NefactPlugin is the official plugin of Nefact SMP.
It introduces powerful artifacts, illegal items, unique crafting rituals, and custom gameplay mechanics designed specifically for the server.
## Resource Pack
The official [NefactPlugin Resource Pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/nefact-texture-pack) is required to fully experience the plugin.

It includes custom item models for artifacts and will continue to expand with future updates.

## Current Artifacts

- Swap Rod
- Stun Slam Mace
- Gateway
- Fast Axe
- Fast Pickaxe
- Heart Stealer Sword
- Auto Crit Sword
- Feather Mace
- Dash Spear
- Warden Mace
- Zeus Trident
- Scythe

More artifacts will be added in future updates.

## Features

- Unique artifacts
- Ritual crafting system
- One unique copy of each artifact per world
- Artifact ownership tracking
- Custom item models
- Recipe GUI
- Dragon Egg tracking
- Configurable cooldowns
- Discord webhook integration

## Commands

- `/nefact`
- `/nefact recipes`
- `/nefact reload`
- `/nefact ritual`
- `/nefact give`
- `/nefact gui`

## About Nefact SMP

Nefact SMP is a **scripted Minecraft server** created by **Ryukoi** for content creation.

The storyline is inspired by events from the server's original unscripted era.

Follow the project through our Discord server.
